kjv: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

lines.say: Before you close your eyes tonight, hear this.
lines.big: Before you close your eyes tonight, hear this

lines.say: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me. Psalm three, verse five.
lines.big: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

lines.say: David slept with enemies outside, and woke up because God held him through the night.
lines.big: David slept with enemies outside, and woke up because God held him through the night.

lines.say: Lord, I lay me down tonight. Sustain me till morning. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 1 through 31, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
